project.name: Lichen CoCulture_I 2 days
project.shortDesc: Co-culture experiment to investigate gene expression in lichenized and non-lichenized partners.
project.longDesc: Co-culture experiment to investigate gene expression in lichenized and non-lichenized partners. 2 days (48 hours) is considered to be the pre-interaction stage in previous lichen co-culture experiments. Partners grown separately and together on 99:1 BMM:MEYE plates. The main lichen association being investigated is between Xanthoria parietina and its Trebouxia photobiont. Additional pairings include Aspergillus nidulans, Cladonia portentosa, Chlorella sorokiniana, and Asterochloris sp.
